name: PetFashion Editorial Lightbox
author: perrtang

sections.description:
A complete free viewer for images and direct MP4/WebM video. Includes English and Traditional Chinese, fixed Dark Mode, basic fades and horizontal/vertical slides, autoplay, gestures, typography and keyboard controls.

PetFashion attribution is optional and OFF by default. Choose Settings > PetFashion Editorial Lightbox > Support PetFashion to enable the logo/link; you can disable it at any time without paying. Upgrading from older versions does not imply consent.

Pro is distributed separately through Freemius. It adds custom logo overlays, translation editing and reusable gallery presets. Pro code and the Freemius SDK are not included in this Free package. Free does not require an account, license connection or external update service.

Privacy and data

No external service or telemetry is required. Settings and uploads stay in WordPress. Remote media/font URLs are requested only when configured by the site administrator. Deactivation and deletion preserve settings and media.

Limits

Initial test release. Direct MP4/WebM only; YouTube/Vimeo, page-builder and WooCommerce-specific integrations are not included. No original PETFASHION photos are included.

Development

The source/ directory contains the Free viewer React source and reproducible build configuration. Run npm ci and npm run build there.

assets/build/editorial-lightbox.js is an unminified, readable JavaScript bundle, including the viewer and its dependencies. PHP source is included. The development project uses React 19.2, Vite 6.4 and Phosphor Icons 2.1; no remote executable code is loaded. English and Traditional Chinese catalogs are in includes/catalogs.json. Licenses for bundled dependencies are in THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt.

Earlier changes

= 0.3.0 =
Add dark/light/automatic appearance, visitor switching and device/scheduled defaults. Follow the current frontend language and the admin user’s language separately. Include English and Traditional Chinese catalogs, page-language detection and translation adapters, and standard gettext/custom filters for other languages. Visitor appearance is stored only in the current browser; it does not sync across devices.

0.2.0

Add loop direction, idle interface hiding and wake, mobile toolbar, pinch/pan/double-tap gestures, intrinsic poster sizing and keyboard-native Space activation. Preserve existing WordPress settings and integrations.

0.1.0

Independent WordPress port of the September 7, 2026 viewer, including photo-edge transitions, segmented cube, linked insets, custom fonts, state colors and video-control settings.
sections.installation:
Upload the ZIP through Plugins > Add Plugin, activate it, then open Settings > PetFashion Editorial Lightbox.
Native Image and Gallery blocks use the viewer. Use [editorial_lightbox ids=”12,34″ columns=”3″] for an explicit gallery. Add elb-disable to a block’s CSS classes to exclude it. Web-page image links remain links.
Edit an image in the Media Library to attach an MP4/WebM URL, AI disclosure or credit/license information.
sections.changelog:
0.4.13

  • Update license activation guidance for the public Pro release.

0.4.12

  • Correct the Pro updater path when an older Editorial Lightbox installation remains on the site.
  • Preserve existing accounts, licenses and settings during the product rename.

0.4.11

  • Rename to PetFashion Editorial Lightbox with the pfelb_ implementation prefix.
  • Provide an independent, fully functional Free settings page and runtime; exclude all paid feature code.
  • Preserve legacy options and media fields during migration. Require manual edition changes instead of deactivating another plugin.

0.4.10

  • Pro: custom play/pause icons, adjustable control icon sizes and transition directions.
  • Live desktop/mobile settings preview.
  • Image loading feedback and retry; latest cube transition fixes.

0.4.9

Fix mixed-aspect cube and mosaic transitions using the incoming image geometry. Stabilize initial fit and preview handoff. Center the dynamic-video badge and honor the hide-interface preference.

0.4.8

Correct Freemius Free/Pro package processing and separate edition bundles.

0.4.7

Sync independent corner content and transition area. Free allows bottom-left text and image-only transitions; Pro allows all corners and display-wide transitions.

0.4.6

Make playback progress Pro-only, expose the Pro eye control, separate fade toggles from effects and hide native video controls.

0.4.5

Add a localized video badge, avoiding AI and custom-logo corners. Hide it in image mode or after video failure.

0.4.4

Sync playback progress, hover pause, navigation styles, independent appearance palettes, Pro mosaic tile counts, video retry and transition handoff fixes. Preserve Free/Pro boundaries and older settings.

0.4.3

Fullscreen and interface auto-hide are now Pro-only. Existing Pro preferences are preserved.

0.4.2

Free: basic fades and horizontal/vertical slides, fixed Dark Mode. Pro: all transitions and appearance switching. Preserve separate Free transition preferences and existing Pro settings.

0.4.1

Split Free and Pro distribution packages. Free contains no Pro workspace, custom watermark renderer or Freemius SDK. Add a new explicit, default-off branding preference independent of previous settings. Preserve saved Pro settings during edition changes.
